# How to manage tensions

Task recipes for the `glassfrog tension` commands. Each section is a single goal.
This guide assumes you know the basics; if you are new to tensions, do the
[tensions tutorial](tutorial.md) first.

## Prerequisites

- A stored API token (`glassfrog auth login`).
- A role id (for capture, list, and roll-up) or a tension id (for get, update, and
  discard). Find role ids with `glassfrog me roles` or `glassfrog roles`.

## Capture a tension with a title and routing hint

```
glassfrog tension create role_0123…  \
  --body "Onboarding checklist is out of date" \
  --label "Onboarding checklist" \
  --meeting-type governance
```

**Verify**: the command produces the created tension with its `ten_` id. Capture
the id with `-o json` (`data.id`) to feed it to a later step.

**Troubleshooting**: `--body` is required and cannot be blank — a missing or
whitespace-only body is rejected (exit 2) before any request. An unsupported
`--meeting-type` (anything but `tactical`/`governance`) is likewise rejected.

## List or roll up tensions

A single role's own tensions:

```
glassfrog tension list role_0123…  --status unprocessed
```

Everything the direct sub-roles of a circle are sensing (one level down, not the
circle's own tensions):

```
glassfrog tension subroles role_0123…
```

**Verify**: both walk every page by default, so the result is complete. With
`--first-page`, watch stderr for a "more exist" note.

**Troubleshooting**: `tension subroles` requires the anchor to be a circle
(`has_subroles: true`); a leaf role returns `404` (exit 3). An unsupported
`--status` value is rejected (exit 2).

## Read one tension

```
glassfrog tension get ten_0123…
```

**Troubleshooting**: `--status` is a list filter only — passing it to `get` is a
usage error (exit 2). An unknown `ten_` id returns `404` (exit 3).

## Edit a tension's body, label, or routing

Supply only the fields you want to change — it is a partial update:

```
glassfrog tension update ten_0123…  --body "Revised wording"
glassfrog tension update ten_0123…  --label "New title" --meeting-type tactical
```

**Verify**: the command returns the updated tension reflecting your changes.

**Troubleshooting**: an update with no field flags is rejected (exit 2) — there
must be something to change. A blank `--body` is a usage error, not a way to clear
the field; there is no way to clear a field to empty.

## Archive a tension you have finished working

```
glassfrog tension update ten_0123…  --status archived
```

`archived` is reached through `update`, not `create` — capture cannot set status.

**Troubleshooting**: a `--status` value outside
`unprocessed`/`processed`/`archived` is rejected (exit 2).

## Discard a tension

```
glassfrog tension discard ten_0123…
```

**Verify**: the command produces a structured discarded-tension result (the
`ten_` id plus a discarded marker) and writes a note to stderr saying whether it
discarded a live tension (`204`) or found it already gone (`404`).

**Note**: discard is a soft-delete — the record is marked, not erased, and the
tension's proposals are left in place. It is retry-safe (a re-run still exits `0`),
but because of that a mistyped id reports success rather than flagging the typo, so
check the id first. There is no confirmation prompt and no way to restore a
discarded tension.

## Common failures

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Exit 2, "not authenticated" | No usable token | Run `glassfrog auth login` or set `GLASSFROG_TOKEN` |
| Exit 2, "`--body` is required" | Missing/blank body on capture | Supply a non-empty `--body` |
| Exit 2, unsupported `--status`/`--meeting-type` | Value outside the vocabulary | Use a supported value (the message lists them) |
| Exit 3, `404` | Unknown id, or leaf-role anchor on `subroles` | Check the id; use a circle for `subroles` |
| Exit 6 | Could not reach the API | Check connectivity |
